# Island Mailer

> Island Mailer is a two-sided Hawaiʻi local platform. For RESIDENTS, it's a free
> way to discover, save, and redeem exclusive deals from locally loved businesses —
> delivered to your mailbox each month and saved on your phone (resident home at /,
> deals at /local-offers). For BUSINESSES, it's a local direct-mail advertising
> service that places businesses on a premium 9×12 EDDM-style shared postcard mailed
> to up to 10,000 local Maui homes (business hub at /advertise). One flat price of
> $800 per ad space includes design, printing, and postage. Only one business per
> industry runs on each mailer.

## Site Structure (two-sided)
- Resident side: the home page (/) is resident-first — "Hawaii's best local deals,
  delivered to your mailbox and inbox" — with an email opt-in, a mailer showcase,
  how-it-works, and a "nominate a local favorite" form. Local Offers lives at
  /local-offers.
- Business side: all advertiser content (pitch, the 9×12 postcard, pricing for the
  Signature and Hyper-Local mailers, how-it-works, FAQ, About, and the apply/contact
  form) lives at /advertise. Product details are at /products. Island and area pages
  cover the geographies served.

## What Island Mailer Is
- A shared (co-op) direct-mail advertising mailer for Hawaiʻi small businesses.
- The product: a large, premium 9×12 postcard ("mailbox billboard") with 16 ad
  spaces total — 8 on the front, 8 on the back.
- Reach: up to 10,000 local households per mailing, delivered via USPS to selected
  Maui mailing routes.
- Price: $800 flat per ad space, per mailing. Design, printing, and postage are all
  included. No long-term contracts — reserve a single mailing or several in a row.
- Exclusivity: one business per industry per mailer, so your category is yours alone.

## Who It's For
- Local Maui small businesses that want to reach residents — not tourists.
- Great fits: restaurants and food trucks, cafés and coffee shops, salons and spas,
  gyms and wellness studios, trades and home services (plumbers, electricians,
  landscapers, cleaners), auto services, real estate / mortgage / insurance, and
  medical, dental, and pet-care providers.
- The goal: help residents discover and support trusted local businesses in their
  own community.

## Areas Served
- Maui (active — mailing now): North Shore (Pāʻia, Haʻikū, Kuʻau), Central (Kahului,
  Wailuku), West Side (Lahaina, Kāʻanapali, Nāpili), South Side (Kīhei, Wailea,
  Mākena), and Upcountry (Makawao, Kula, Pukalani).
- Kauai (waitlist — coming soon): East Side (Kapaa, Wailua), North Shore (Hanalei,
  Princeville), South Shore (Poipu, Koloa), West Side (Waimea, Hanapepe), and Lihue.
- Oahu (waitlist — coming soon): North Shore (Haleiwa, Kahuku), Windward (Kailua,
  Kaneohe), Central (Mililani, Wahiawa), Leeward (Kapolei, Ewa Beach), and Honolulu.
- Big Island / Hawaiʻi Island (waitlist — coming soon): Hilo, Hamakua, South Kohala
  (Waimea, Kohala Coast), North Kona (Kailua-Kona), South Kona, Puna (Pahoa), and Ka'u.
- Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi — businesses can join the waitlist to be notified when a mailer
  is scheduled in their area.
- On the new islands (Kauai, Oahu, Big Island) Island Mailer is not mailing yet:
  area pages route to the waitlist (e.g. /waitlist?island=Kauai) instead of the
  Maui reservation form.
